_doc: Workspace-scoped MCP servers for Kiln. See docs/decisions/2026-05-21-tooling-recommendation.md for rationale.
_dbhub_note: ACTIVE. DSN points at ~/.kiln/kiln.db (user-home convention, NOT %AppData%/kiln/).
_dbhub_v0_21_2_quirks_2026_05_21: 1) --max-rows and --query-timeout were silently dropped from the v0.21.2 release on npm; pass row-limit config via dbhub.toml [[tools]] block when needed. 2) better-sqlite3 is no longer bundled — must be installed into the npx cache dir manually. Procedure if SQLite connector errors with 'driver package better-sqlite3 not installed': locate the npx cache via `ls C:/Users/chawo/AppData/Local/npm-cache/_npx/*/node_modules/@bytebase/dbhub`, cd to the cache root, `npm install --no-save better-sqlite3`.
_android_mcp_note: Two pinned entries — Pixel 10 Pro XL (primary daily driver, 58081FDCQ000EB) and Pixel 7 Pro (factory-reset secondary, 2A261FDH300B1P). Each pins --device so concurrent USB attachment doesn't ambiguate adb. If a device is disconnected, that server shows as unavailable in CC; the other still works. PATH points at the canonical SDK location per CLAUDE.md (AppData\Local\Android\Sdk), not C:\Users\chawo\Android\Sdk.
